ticket.subject: Bulk edit greyed out (and PDF logo)
ticket.body_text:
Hi,

The bulk-edit button greys out as soon as I select more than 50 rows. We are doing our quarterly cleanup this week and have about 900 rows to change. We can do it 50 at a time, but it is slow.

Smaller thing: exported PDFs are missing our logo since the last release.

Regards,
Sofia

label_notes: multi_issue: bulk edit blocks the customer most (bug, workaround in batches = P3, this week = medium). Second issue: missing logo in PDF exports (bug, cosmetic).
